original_policy: At most one fresh rerun after infrastructure failure.
amended_policy: At most two fresh reruns after infrastructure failure, for all candidates. First valid trial is retained; never rerun a valid trial for score selection.
reason: GLM first attempt failed in main-model transport, second in independent shared visual service. Allow one additional recovery attempt without altering frozen task, tools, scorer, reasoning or logical budgets.

executor_incident.cause: Recovery processes overlapped the suite; gateway rejected concurrent usage. This is an execution infrastructure incident, not model behavior.
executor_incident.correction: After currently running trials finish, replace the affected GLM attempt once in serial. Keep it published as invalid; no valid model trial is replaced.
